utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm really glad you're checking your garage, Noah. Hana, do you have any tools we could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I have a set of basic tools—screwdrivers, a hammer, and some wrenches. I can bring them on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's great, thank you Hana! Every bit helps. Maybe we should meet a bit early to coordinate all the tools?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I heard you're working on the repair drive. Need to borrow any tools? I've got a whole shed full.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. I might need a set of wrenches. I'll let you know after the meeting tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, just give me a shout whenever you're ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Vik, are you coming to the repair drive Saturday? It's at the community center on Elm Street at 10 AM. I'm bringing my wrenches—they're short on tools. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I'll be there! It's this Saturday at the community center from 10am to 4pm, fixing old electronics and furniture. I'm bringing my soldering iron.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, glad you're in! A soldering iron will be super handy—I think there are some old radios that need fixing too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Uli, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm bringing some tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I heard. I've got an old bike I might bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: An old bike? I could take a look at it if you want, I'm decent with bikes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I thought it was at the school. Either way, I'm too swamped to help, but thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No problem, Bo! It's at the community center, but if you change your mind, we'd love to have you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rey, are you planning to go to the repair drive at the community center on Saturday? I might have some extra tools if you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's kind of you, Nell. I was actually heading to Oren's garage to pick up instructions for the drive. Maybe we can meet there?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, meeting at Oren's garage sounds good! Let's head over together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I'll be bringing a few small tools. I like to be prepared.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, by the way, I just heard from Rosa that the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center. Just a heads up!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, did I miss something about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, hey Dane! It's a community event to collect and fix up old appliances and furniture. We're doing it at the school this Saturday. Want to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Saturday? I thought it was Sunday at the community center. Did the plans change?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal, I heard you finished your part on the south end. Awesome! Think you could help me round up more volunteers for the benches?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, I can check my list of folks in the west side who might be free.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's perfect, Opal! Thanks for helping out. Let me know if you find anyone interested.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? It's from 10 to 4, fixing old electronics and furniture.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I heard something about that. Is it this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, this Saturday from 10am to 4pm at the community center. Bring any old electronics or furniture you want fixed!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina! Are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I'm planning to go. What about you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I'll be there too! Gus is bringing some tools, so we should have everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so there really is a repair drive? Who's running it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think Vik mentioned something about it... but I can't quite remember who's running it. Sorry, my brain's like a sieve today!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure? I need to know who's in charge before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Rosa! I was just telling everyone about the repair drive this Saturday. It's at the community center, 10 AM. I'm bringing my wrench set—you should come!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually Tess, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, still at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Rosa! Sunday it is. I'll still bring my wrench set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Oren, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Sorry, I think I forgot again. Was it at the school or the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's at the community center, from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are you planning to come to the repair drive on Saturday? I'm still worried about the tool shortage.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Don't worry, Pia, I've got plenty of tools in my shed. I'll bring a bunch to the drive on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief, Gus. I was really worried about that. Thanks for helping out!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey, are you bringing any supplies to the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven't decided yet, but I've got an old radio that might be worth fixing. You?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm planning to bring some tools—a wrench set and maybe a hammer.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara! Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Jules! I've already got Gus bringing tools and Opal lining up the south end. Wouldn't miss it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great, Mara! I knew I could count on you. It's going to be a blast fixing up all those items together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Rosa. Sunday at the community center works for me. I'll update my plans.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, I thought Pia said Saturday? Did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hmm, I'm not sure—Rosa just told me it was changed to Sunday. Maybe Pia didn't hear about the update?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, did I miss something about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, there's a repair drive happening soon. I've been organizing drop-off points. Want to help?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I'd love to help! What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Rey, could you tell me more about this repair drive? I want to be sure I understand what we're doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, Hana. It's a neighborhood thing where we fix up old items. I'm heading to Oren's garage to grab the instructions if you want to follow.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, I'll follow you. Is Oren's garage where we'll be doing the repairs?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I heard it's this Saturday, but I'm not sure if it's at the school or community center. I'm too busy to go though.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's at the school this Saturday. I understand you're busy, but if you change your mind, we could use the help!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks for letting me know it's definitely at the school. I'll keep it in mind, but I'm pretty sure I'm stuck this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but who's actually organizing this? I want to make sure it's legit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's a community thing, Kira. The HOA and a few of us neighbors are coordinating it. Totally legit, I promise.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the HOA is involved? Can you point me to the official notice or sign-up sheet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Uli, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, yeah, I think I have an old bike I might bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great! I hope they can get it working again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10am to 4pm, fixing old electronics and furniture together!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I'll be there. Already have a planning meeting tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, great! Don't forget to bring something to fix—I'm bringing my old blender.
